market_mood: A turbulent seas of emotions, with sudden waves of energy stirring up the crypto surf.
astro_justification: With the Sun in Cancer forming squares to both Moon and Saturn, alongside the Moon's fiery Aries energy, expect both sensitivity and tension; Mercury retrograde complicates communication further.

BTC.reason: Market hesitance as emotions are high and communication falters.

ETH.reason: Building momentum as recent innovations spark interest amid the chaos.

ALTS.reason: Most altcoins feel the chill of uncertainty, struggling to gain traction.

quote: When planets clash and moons collide, hold your tokens tight; the tides may hide!
